gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Horseshoe curves and sturdy diagonals make this pair hard to ignore. Cherry Swash handles the attitude, while Bai Jamjuree quietly keeps its light, round letters free of any stroke contrast.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: A wide-open horseshoe c and sturdy diagonals lead the way. Tenor Sans, with stems a little heavier than its hairlines, can sit noticeably smaller under Cherry Swash without losing its footing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-albert-sans: Ruler-straight lines and gappy e's give this pair a bold swagger. Happy Monkey brings the loud personality, and Albert Sans keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes, so the difference in temperament is what stands out.
